title: A stale feedback.ids takeover guard is removed by path, so a live guard can be deleted and two takers hold the lock
goal: ql_capture._take_stale_ids_lock removes a stale takeover guard only while it still holds the remover's own token, so two takers never both hold feedback.ids.lock when a dead taker left its guard
repro_reason: a race of eight threads over a dead guard: three of a hundred rounds gave two holders in the reviewer's measurement, so no single run fails every time
